verdict.rationale: GitHub offers building blocks relevant to governance—CI/CD via Actions (github-docs-11), branch protection/permissions APIs (github-docs-18/19), secret scanning and push protection (github-docs-7/15), and code security features (github-docs-5/6/14)—but there is no direct evidence of organization-wide policy enforcement, required status checks, or rulesets across teams/repos. Community evidence also raises reliability concerns for Actions outages (github-comm-18) that could undermine consistent CI/CD enforcement.
